name: bitbucket-mcp
description: Bitbucket repositories, pull requests, comments and pipelines over MCP, with pagination metadata, sorting and retries. Reads the same credentials file as the mcp-atlassian plugin.

bitbucket_url.title: Bitbucket API URL
bitbucket_url.description: Leave empty for Bitbucket Cloud (https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0). For Server/DC, the REST base URL of your instance.

bitbucket_workspace.title: Default workspace
bitbucket_workspace.description: The workspace tools use when a call names none, e.g. your-company.

bitbucket_username.title: Account email
bitbucket_username.description: The Atlassian account email the API token belongs to. Leave empty when using an access token.

bitbucket_password.title: API token (with account email)
bitbucket_password.description: An Atlassian API token with Bitbucket scopes, used together with the account email.

bitbucket_token.title: Access token (bearer)
bitbucket_token.description: Alternative to email + API token: a workspace, project or repository access token, sent as a bearer token.

server_source.title: Run from this checkout instead
server_source.description: Optional. Point this at a built clone of the repository to run that working tree rather than the copy shipped with the plugin. Equivalent to setting BITBUCKET_MCP_DIR.
